title: What Does the Bible Say About Suicide? 25 Verses of Hope
description: If you are thinking about suicide, call or text 988 now. What the Bible says to people in despair, with 25 verses on God's nearness, rest and hope.
keywords: what does the bible say about suicide
bible verses about wanting to die

notice.title: If you are thinking about ending your life, please reach out now.
lines: In the US, call or text 988 to reach the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or text HOME to 741741 for Crisis Text Line. Both are free, confidential and open 24/7.
Outside the US, findahelpline.com lists free helplines in more than 175 countries.
If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.

summary: The word suicide never appears in the Bible. What the Bible does show, more than once, is faithful people in such despair that they asked God to let them die: Moses (Numbers 11:15), Elijah (1 Kings 19:4), Job (Job 3:11) and Jonah (Jonah 4:3). God did not turn away from any of them. He gave Moses seventy elders to share his load, sent Elijah food and sleep, answered Job, and kept talking with Jonah. The verses below are about that nearness: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart (Psalm 34:18), and nothing can separate us from God's love (Romans 8:38-39).

faqs.q: What does the Bible say about suicide?

faqs.a: The word suicide is not in the Bible, in the King James Version or the World English Bible. Scripture does record people who were so worn down that they asked God to take their life, among them Moses, Elijah, Job and Jonah, and it shows God caring for each of them: help for Moses, food and rest for Elijah, an answer for Job, and patient words for Jonah.

faqs.q: What Bible verse helps when you feel like giving up?
faqs.a: Psalm 34:18: "Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit." Jesus' invitation in Matthew 11:28 is another: "Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest." If you are thinking about suicide, please also call or text 988 today.

faqs.q: Where can I get help right now?
faqs.a: In the US, call or text 988 for the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or text HOME to 741741 for Crisis Text Line. Both are free, confidential and open 24/7. Outside the US, findahelpline.com lists free helplines in more than 175 countries. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
